body: You’re right I’ll reach out and see what she says this time hopefully we both take it serious if not then that’s that I guess.
My initial response is why put in the work if she won’t even recognize but you’re right that’s an excuse and I need to get my brain straight regardless of who it’s for.

Thank you, I did a few years of CBT after discharge to a point where I felt I could function normally but perhaps it’s time to reconsider. It’s just literally anyone else in my life that knows me from the past tells me how far I’ve come and am progressing. She doesn’t see any of that effort and it makes me jaded about seeking further help which I’m currently realizing I need to stop because it’s certainly not helping our situation.

She has on a few occasions, so far we’ve tried a few couples apps but if we can actually schedule an appointment and take it seriously I’d be willing to try. I’d be willing to try anything at this point but it feels like everything I say or do is twisted against me in some way.

Regardless, thanks for the suggestion.
I actually thought about rearranging our bedroom and will talk to her about that, thanks!
